text:
deploy-bot: deploy v2026.03.21.1 to canary completed in eu1. automated post-deploy synths started. seeing drop in synthetic hit rate for embed-route (~40% lower than baseline). :thinking:

jess: noticed same, KV hit-rate down in the warm-cache window. logs show a lot of cold-reads on prefix-cache during the 00:00-00:05 window. snippet from node logs: `prefill: started=0 ended=0 samples=0`

ryan: hmm canary traffic looked normal, but synth traffic is being sampled differently. could be the new sampler change from yesterday. did we flip sampler-ratio in this deploy?

amanda: @jess @ryan if this is a sampling change we should decide whether to pin canary to previous sampler until we confirm. we have 30min grace for post-deploy checks.

jess: no flip in code; the sampler config rollout was scheduled for next week. this looks like a race in the backfill job where some shards failed to claim the replay lease. see error in backfill-controller: `leaseAcquisitionTimeout`

ryan: ok. quick mitigation options: 1) trigger a manual backfill/replay job to populate KV, 2) roll back sampler-affecting config (if any), 3) hold rollout and pin canary to previous image.

sanjay: prefer manual backfill first (less blast radius). command I use for backfill-runner: `./infra/tools/backfill-runner --synth-set embed-route --window 5m --parallel 8`

amanda: if we run that, how long until synth p95 should recover?

sanjay: typically 6-12 minutes for warm-cache to converge on eu1 at that parallelism. if p95 doesn't drop below 200ms after 20m, escalate rollback.

jess: created quick adhoc job and kicked it off with the command above. job id 20260321-eu1-jnk. infra-bot: started job 20260321-eu1-jnk (workers=8)

infra-bot: backfill job 20260321-eu1-jnk heartbeat: 00:01:25 processed=12k prefills=9.5k errors=0

ryan: nice. putting the global rollout on hold for now. canary still running but we paused ramp to 50% -> 25%. :hand:
amanda: noted. I'll also pin routing config for eu1 to v2026.03.20.9 just in case. that's a soft pin, we can unpin after green.

jess: live metrics: synth hit-rate recovering to 82% of baseline, p95 trending 170ms (was 420ms). will keep monitoring.

sanjay: thanks. can we surface an alert if p95 > 250ms for 5m? that should trigger an auto-rollback window.

infra-bot: alert rule created: synth.embed-route.eu1.p95 > 250ms for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall + postmortem flag.

amanda: decision: run backfill -> hold rollout -> pin routing -> monitor 20m. rollback only if p95 stays over 250ms for 5 continuous minutes after full backfill.

ryan: agreed. I'll prepare rollback cut if needed; but let's give the backfill 15 more minutes. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

jess: will post a short summary to release notes channel after we confirm green. current status: backfill running, rollout held, pin applied. tracking job: 20260321-eu1-jnk.

deploy-bot: deploy window remains open. will not continue global ramp until manual resume.

amanda: thanks team. if anything changes ping this thread. otherwise plan to unpin and finish rollout once p95 stable for two consecutive 5m buckets.

ryan: (or rollback if infra-bot fires).
